pit_message_text

Language specific message text repository.

Fields
pmt_pms_name

Message name. Reference to PIT_MESSAGE.

pmt_pml_name

Language reference of the message text. Taken from Oracle v$nls_valid_values.

pmt_text

Message text. Positional replacement with pattern #n#.

pmt_description

Optional description to further describe the error or provide help on how to solve the issue.
